verdict.rationale: Reducto's Parse endpoint returns figures as typed elements with page position and bounding boxes, and an agentic r-1 mode offers advanced chart extraction. Together these cover extracting figures and charts traceably back to the source page. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of VLM-generated figure summaries or descriptions, image crop output for figures, and independent hands-on corroboration of figure and chart extraction quality.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, figures and charts are extracted or described (VLM summaries, image crops) with positions traceable back to the source page

citations.quote: It converts documents into structured JSON with text, tables, figures, layout, and formatting
Each element includes its type, page position, and confidence score.
Reducto parse r-1 delivers agentic-quality parsing for text, tables, figures, layout, and formatting in one full-page pass, with bounding boxes
Use agentic processing with r-1 when your workflow needs a custom prompt for a specific content type or advanced chart extraction.
